answer: Like a mycorrhizal mycelium anchoring fragile soil into a solid knoll, decentralized consensus resists Sybil floods through transitive trust staking. Believing an entity can split without consequence is an empty fable; here, validating peers allocate stake along verified relational pathways where attacker cost scales exponentially with identity count. Spawning phantom nodes plunges an adversary’s capital efficiency to its nadir.
